rules.title: Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition/Permanent Removal, Temporary Capital Improvement Work, or Substantial Rehabilitation Evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal of a unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation payments. The amount depends on the date the eviction notice is served; for notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27 it is $8,245.00 per tenant, up to $24,733.00 per unit, plus $5,497.00 for each elderly (60 years or older) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren).
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; maximum $24,733.00 per unit; plus $5,497.00 for each elderly (60 years or older) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren) (notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal of unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation; additional amount for elderly (60 years or older) or disabled tenants or households with minor children.
rules.exemptions: Relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.interaction_text: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act must receive relocation payments based on the date the eviction notice is served; for notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27 the amount is $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62 years or older) or disabled tenant.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; maximum $33,330.13 per unit; plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62 years or older) or disabled tenant (notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act; additional amount for each elderly (62 years or older) or disabled tenant.
